Subject: Migration kick-off: request to schedule architecture bridge

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

We're getting accelerated by the business to move off our current inference provider and run a formal architecture deep-dive with Redwood as the primary candidate. Goal is to validate the cutover plan, confirm throughput/latency expectations, and walk the POC runbook.

Would like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical bridge (engineers + infra) next week. Our team availability (PDT):
- Tue Sep 22: 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 23: 14:00–15:30 (preferred)
- Thu Sep 24: 08:00–09:30

I've attached a brief inventory (endpoints, current infra, models in use) to help scope the session. Primary stakeholders: Tyler Brooks (ML eng), Jordan Lee (PM), Procurement inbox. We have a hard target to be ready for internal cutover testing by Oct 15, so want to lock this in ASAP.

Attachment: brightline-inventory.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

Thanks,
Tyler Brooks
Director, Machine Learning Engineering
Brightline Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Migration kick-off: request to schedule architecture bridge

Tyler — thanks for the context and the inventory. Wed Sep 23 14:00–15:30 PDT (90 mins) should work for our team; I'll tentatively hold that window.

Before we lock, a couple quick asks so we can tailor the deep-dive:
1) Target POC goals: cutover test only, or production ramp? (helps set SLOs)
2) Expected peak throughput and average payload (tokens per request)
3) Any regulatory/residency constraints we need to prepare for
4) Are there specific models or checkpoints you plan to bring, or is this vendor-agnostic?

We'll bring our POC playbook and an initial runbook draft (redwood-poc-playbook.pdf) and allocate a runtime engineer to discuss batching/kv-cache tradeoffs.

I'll also loop in Procurement on approvals and network egress details — can procurement confirm the firewall IPs and VPN window requirements?

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
